comment: cmd.c dosuspend_core() with the tty window port, which can always suspend, calls sys/share/ioctl.c dosuspend(). The recorder's sysconf sets no SHELLERS, so ^Z prints "Suspend command not available." through Norep(); the second ^Z repeats it and Norep() suppresses it, and #suspend reaches the same handler. A final search shows the commands took no time.
